changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO game_access (game_id, scope, scope_value, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT g.id, 'all', NULL, 'system:migration-051', NOW() FROM games g WHERE g.slug IN ( 'chess', 'connect-four', 'reversi', 'gomoku', 'dots-and-boxes', 'go', 'battleship', 'tetris', 'minesweeper', 'sudoku', 'match-three', 'tron', 'bomberman', 'asteroids-duel' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM game_access ga WHERE ga.game_id = g.id AND ga.scope = 'all' AND ga.scope_value IS NULL );
